clips.title: The story
paras: Alther's Mill is a pivotal training assignment given to Alliance rogues by Lucius in Lakeshire. Dispatched to the nearby mill with a set of thieves' tools, initiates are tasked with infiltrating an area under Blackrock orc scrutiny to crack a locked chest and retrieve a token of thievery.

In Lakeshire, rogue instructors do not bother with abstract lectures when a locked chest can teach the lesson faster. Lucius sends promising operatives northeast along the road to Alther's Mill, equipping them with their first set of thieves' tools. To earn their formal Certificate of Thievery, novices must slip into the abandoned mill, pick open Lucius's personal lockbox, and bring back the token cached within.

While Alther's Mill was once an ordinary lumber outpost, it has recently drawn the dangerous attention of the Blackrock orcs encroaching upon Redridge. Lucius gleefully treats the encroaching warmongers as an added layer of practical examination. Prowling through enemy-held territory to pick locks undetected is precisely the kind of trial SI:7 expects its agents to survive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.
Up off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did I forget to mention the orcs?
I hear they have been nosing around up by the mill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, friend.
If you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
